adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, the import path now does `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and passes `category: eh.try(:category_id)` to `PostCreator`. If `record_for_host` returns nil (e.g., URL host is `www.example.com` but stored host is `example.com`, or other host mismatch), `category` becomes nil and there is no fallback or error. Since the global `SiteSetting.embed_category` was removed in this diff, this can lead to embeds being created without the intended category (likely default/Uncategorized depending on `PostCreator` behavior) with no warning.
